Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row I – A, B, C and D are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row II – V, X, Y and Z are seated and all of them are facing north.

B is the only neighbour of A and A sits exactly opposite Y. V sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite C. D sits to the immediate left of C and exactly opposite X.

Who sits at the immediate left of Y?
questions.solution:

• Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows with 4 people each in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.
 
• In row I – A, B, C and D are seated and all of them are facing south.
 
• In row II – V, X, Y and Z are seated and all of them are facing north.

Explanation :

1) V sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/193e94de547c3f015391709cd1f8d7fafa2987043a0818549f903ac0f1e5f3ae.png] 

2) D sits to the immediate left of C and exactly opposite X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/594a52916b85d23450a45601f3bf856e570e8039b917cf8ec099316d690372d1.png] 

3) B is the only neighbour of A and A sits exactly opposite Y.

After positioning B, A and Y only one position is left in row - II which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d0a6d6fbc6e80216239ce334e9275c7dd60a4a46ebfc3e7323b4e778aa9d162.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Z sits at the immediate left of Y.

Hence, **"Z"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some tapes are glue.

Some glue are paints.

All paints are computers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tapes are paints.

II. All glue are paints.

III. Some glue are computers.
questions.solution:

I. Some tapes are paints → Does not Follow (As, some tapes are glue and some glue are paints. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

II. All glue are paints → Does not Follow (As, some glue are paints. So, some part of glue is common with paints therefore it is false.)

III. Some glue are computers → Follow (As, some glue are paints and all paints are computers . So, whole paints comes in computers and have some part common with glue therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion III follows".

questions.question: Which of the following is a symptom of bacterial infection?

• ** Fever is a common symptom of bacterial infection as the body's immune system responds to the presence of bacteria by raising the internal temperature.**

• However, bacterial infections can sometimes lead to complications that affect the heart or other organs.
 
• For example, untreated streptococcal infections can cause rheumatic fever, which can damage the heart valves.
 
• It is important to seek medical attention if you suspect you have a bacterial infection, as prompt treatment can prevent serious complications.
